recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: bugs that even memory-safe languages let through
the early internet remembered as one shared room
smarter routing of tokens, lighter cloud bills
clear night over the bay, breeze off the water
late April spring, still jacket-and-coffee weather

composer-2-fast.concept: Catch pulses that spawn on a stutter-house beat—left and right lanes, three misses and the loop snaps shut.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: tap left or right half of the screen
composer-2-fast.session_hook: one tight song-length run, streak multipliers for perfect catches
composer-2-fast.escalation: ghost echoes spawn off-beat, effective tempo inches up
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: neon grid floor, club haze, sharp particle hits

gpt-5.4-high-fast.concept: Draw a path through beach-town fog for a tiny traveler; ink fades when you lift your finger, so you retrace from memory.
gpt-5.4-high-fast.touch_control: drag to sketch path, release to lock step
gpt-5.4-high-fast.session_hook: reach the warm beacon before the fog ring closes
gpt-5.4-high-fast.escalation: shorter memory windows, moving hazards along shore drift
gpt-5.4-high-fast.aesthetic: soft watercolor mist, one distant sodium light

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Triage a sprint of glitchy 'compiler whispers' into fix now, park, or delete—wrong bins stack panic debt.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: three-pile sort with fake duplicate cards
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: swipe cards left, up, or right
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: inbox-zero heroics in under a minute
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: spawn rate spikes, decoy tickets with identical icons
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: terminal green on cream paper, sticky-note chaos

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick origami boats across a sidewalk puddle; spring gusts bend arcs before they slip the drain.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: pull back and release slingshot on the boat
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: sink five boats in the glowing drain cup
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wind vector shifts mid-air, puddle shrinks toward drought
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: muted spring pastels, wet concrete sheen

kimi-k2.5.concept: Merge pastel tiles on a single screen until they ring a chord—illegal merges crack the board like cheap vinyl.
kimi-k2.5.touch_control: tap two touching tiles to fuse
kimi-k2.5.session_hook: complete the hidden chord pattern before the needle skips
kimi-k2.5.escalation: locked cells and 'wrong-note' tiles that punish greedy taps
kimi-k2.5.aesthetic: French indie gig-poster collage, chalk and ink blocks
